svg.aria-label: A-OK Blind Bridge. ESP32 firmware. Local control of 433 MHz A-OK blind motors (sold as Motolux and others) with an ESP32 and a CC1101 radio, about A$15 of parts. Learns your remote, follows it, and adds positions, scenes and schedules. Install it from your browser.
